text:
Deadlines are a part of professional life, but they don't have to be a source of constant stress. The key is effective time management. Start by breaking a large project into smaller, manageable tasks and estimating how long each will take. This helps you see the full picture and avoid last-minute panic.

Prioritization is equally important. Not all tasks are created equal, so focus on the most critical ones first, even if they are not the most enjoyable. Sometimes, you will face an unrealistic request. This is where scope management comes in. Be honest with yourself about what you can achieve, and be willing to negotiate the requirements or the timeline.

Finally, never underestimate the power of communication. If you foresee a problem, inform your team or manager early. This gives everyone a chance to adjust plans, rather than being surprised by a missed date.
